title: Portfolio - Product Feedback Intelligence API
description: Local product feedback intelligence workflow: validates feedback intake, classifies theme/sentiment/urgency via an LLM-in-the-loop classifier with a deterministic fallback and confidence gate, derives urgency, scores priority, gates churn-risk/critical items for human review, and emits a redacted audit event.
integrations: n8n Execute Workflow Trigger (passthrough) -- callable IN-PROCESS by the interaction-gateway (YKT4FJmC8Xg2G9hs); feeds the SAME Normalize Feedback Payload pipeline, webhook contract unchanged
notes: v0.2.0 wires a live Ollama classifier path (HTTP to host.docker.internal:11434, model llama3.2:3b), selected per request via classifierMode='ollama' and verified end-to-end. The deterministic stub remains the default so CI and the 10-fixture behavioral eval stay offline and reproducible (still 10/10). The confidence gate falls back to the keyword classifier on low-confidence or invalid model output. 2026-06-03: ADDED an executeWorkflowTrigger (passthrough) so the interaction-gateway (YKT4FJmC8Xg2G9hs) can route to this SUT IN-PROCESS via Execute Workflow (proven live: signed 'product-feedback' intent -> real theme/sentiment/urgency back). The trigger is ADDITIVE -- it feeds the same Normalize Feedback Payload node the webhook does, and the webhook contract was regression-tested after redeploy (theme=bug / theme=praise, unchanged). Canonical is now 29 nodes (28 + the trigger). DEPLOY NOTE: this repo's primary toolchain is the n8n MCP (validate_workflow/update_workflow); since no MCP was connected this session, the workflow.js was compiled via the standalone @n8n/workflow-sdk compiler (it reproduced the 28 nodes exactly, then +1 trigger) and deployed via the public REST API (PUT + activate). Re-syncing via the MCP path remains valid (the SDK source is the source of truth).
